name: Instagram Caption
description: Writes Instagram captions with a hook line, story body, hashtag strategy, and platform-optimized call-to-action. Use when the user wants to write an Instagram caption, create Instagram content, or draft text to accompany an Instagram post or reel. Do NOT use for LinkedIn posts (use `linkedin-post`), Twitter threads (use `twitter-thread`), or blog posts (use `blog-post-writing`).
